name: HAR Viewer
description: Shows .har and Playwright .har.zip files as a network log: request list, waterfall, filters and each request's headers, payload, response, cookies, timing and WebSocket frames. Copy as cURL, export an agent digest, save a masked copy. Independent; not affiliated with Playwright or any browser maker.

cover.alt: Spot failures fast: 29 requests with a waterfall, and the 500 Internal Server Error of POST export with its headers on the right.

screenshots.alt: Narrow to what broke: Errors and Fetch/XHR show 4 of 29 requests, and the overview counts 4xx 2, 5xx 1 and (failed) 1.
Read JSON as a tree: the response of GET orders?limit=20&status=open with items Array(20) and the next-page link.
See where time went: POST export waited 1.20 s for the server, and Server-Timing shows Postgres 1.10 s and app 96 ms.
Share without secrets: 28 secret values masked in 15 requests, and an agent digest showing authorization: Bearer [masked].
